name: Ethernet cable (Cat 5e or better)
summary: A wired connection is the single most reliable fix for online lag caused by unstable Wi-Fi. Any decent Cat 5e or Cat 6 cable is enough for gaming; you do not need an expensive one.
lookFor: Cat 5e or Cat 6 rating (both support gigabit speeds)
Length long enough to reach your router without strain, with a little slack
Snag-less connectors and a flat or thin cable if you need to run it along a wall
Skip gold-plated marketing claims; they do not change gaming performance
suitableFor: Anyone whose PC or console is within cable reach of the router and who suffers from spikes or packet loss on Wi-Fi.
pros: Typically lower and more stable latency than Wi-Fi
cons: A cable has to be run through the room
Does nothing if the problem is your internet provider or the game's servers
